summary: Smoke-tested backend APIs and full UI (admin + employee flows) for the French Helpdesk/Stock app. All features from the review request work end-to-end: ID-only login (case-insensitive), invalid-ID error, admin dashboard KPIs, Tous les tickets (list/search/filter/detail save), inventory +/- adjust + low-stock toggle, reminders view, connection logs, employee role scoping and isolation, employee ticket creation. Backend endpoints /api/auth/login, /api/meta, /api/stats, /api/tickets (GET/POST/PATCH + creator_id filter), /api/inventory, /api/reminders, /api/logs all return 2xx with valid data.
passed: POST /api/auth/login accepts case-insensitive ID (emp-alex -> EMP-ALEX, role=admin)
POST /api/auth/login returns 404 'ID employé introuvable' for unknown ID
GET /api/stats returns KPIs (open_tickets=6, low_stock=3, resolved=2, logs_today>=3)
GET /api/tickets returns 8 seeded tickets; GET /api/tickets?creator_id=EMP-001 returns only EMP-001 tickets
POST /api/tickets creates ticket with creator_name auto-filled; PATCH /api/tickets/{id} updates status/assignee/notes (200)
GET /api/inventory returns 12 items, /api/reminders returns 4, /api/logs returns connection entries
UI: invalid login ID shows 'introuvable' error
UI: Admin login via EMP-ALEX quick chip -> Tableau de bord with KPI cards + recent tickets + status breakdown + upcoming reminders
UI: Admin nav shows Tableau de bord/Tous les tickets/Gestion du stock/Alertes & rappels/Logs de connexion
UI: Tous les tickets lists 9 rows, ticket detail opens, status select + notes + save button works (save succeeded)
UI: Inventory shows 12 items with qty-plus/qty-minus; +1 persists; Stock bas toggle filters list
UI: Alertes & rappels view and Logs de connexion view load with entries
UI: Employee login (EMP-001) shows ONLY Mes tickets/Nouveau ticket/Mon profil nav; no Stock/Logs/Dashboard links
UI: Employee creates new ticket via form (title/description/category/priority/submit) -> appears in Mes tickets
UI: Employee isolation verified - Mes tickets contains no EMP-002/EMP-003/EMP-ALEX IDs
notes: One benign console 404 observed (likely favicon or similar static asset); no functional impact. Data-testids are consistently present and reliable.
